description: Lock one table of a wiki page against edits, or lift its lock (PM-1540) — for a table that must stay as approved, such as rates. While it is locked, a write by anybody else that changes it, removes it, lifts its lock or locks another table is refused on every door, and the rest of the page stays theirs to edit. Only the page's owner (whoever made it) and the project's administrators may lock, unlock or change a locked table. 'table' is the table's place among the page's tables, from 0 — get_wiki_page's 'tables[].table', 'lockedTables'. A Markdown table locked is rewritten in the rich form ({table:lock=on}), with its cells as they were. A new version of the page; answers with 'lockedTables'.

locked.description: True to lock, false to lift the lock.

spaceKey.description: Space key, when identifying the page by title.

table.description: The table's place among the page's tables, from 0.

title.description: Exact page title, when identifying the page by title.
